mentions.h: JUNIORS SHINE- SENIORS DULL SURREY X-COUNTRY CHAMPIONSHIP-CHESSINGTON 2ND JAN
SPOTLIGHT: BISHOP HARRIERS (ALAN, LEN, ERIC) FOUNDED 1943
mentions.note: H.A. Bishop; joined June 1943; carried the Olympic torch towards Wembley 1948; 12th London to Brighton 52 miles; won Club 20 miles; repeatedly under 2h 45m marathon; Track and Distance Running Captain
office colleague who introduced Barry Sawyer to the club in 1959
46th 3:02:11; completed qualification for Club second class standard
ran in the first Hog's Back race, 1958
fourth Belgrave scorer in the Open Race
Fairfield's neighbour, George Piddington's old friend; not the Alan Bishop of the three Bishop brothers

photos.c: From left to right, Norman Stairs, Barry Sawyer, Alan Bishop, Len Bishop, John Moore, Charlie Walker, Denis Jones, and Derek Crookes. This picture was taken at Windsor Castle just before they were sent on their way by Her Majesty The Queen.
